verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a dedicated SOC 2 product. It covers automated tests and evidence collection with continuous monitoring, a pre-built framework and control library, AI policy drafting, and audit features including auditor collaboration and Information Request Lists. However, the pack never explicitly addresses Type I versus Type II engagements or names the Trust Services Criteria, so the full scope of the story is not documented. Missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II support, explicit Trust Services Criteria control mapping, a documented required-policy template set for SOC 2, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform
